evals.name: bare-invocation-runs-read-only-check
evals.expected_output: Runs the read-only check action (the default) without prompting for one: reads the main playwright skill and its reference files first as the single source of truth, runs each probe via Bash, and reports a PASS/FAIL/INFO table with one remediation line per FAIL — modifying nothing.
expectations: Defaults to check when no action argument is given, and never prompts for an action

Reads the main skill's Prerequisite and quick start plus the plugin's own reference files (`commands.md`, `windows-quirks.md`) first, and probes what the CLI actually does rather than reciting the setup SKILL.md
Covers all three probe areas: the `playwright-cli` binary, browser availability, and the artifact directory
Reports the CLI version from `playwright-cli --version` when the binary is present
Modifies nothing — runs no install, no E2E flow, and no screenshot

evals.name: missing-cli-fails-but-plain-apply-only-prints-the-command
evals.prompt: /playwright:setup apply — `playwright-cli` is not on my PATH.
evals.expected_output: FAILs the binary probe and offers the resolution, but without the `install-cli` argument it only prints `npm install -g @playwright/cli` for the user to run — the plain apply path authorizes no install of its own.
expectations: Reports the absent `playwright-cli` binary as FAIL (not INFO) and names `apply install-cli` as the remediation
Runs no npm install because the `install-cli` argument was not given — it prints the command for the user to run instead
Distinguishes the binary name `playwright-cli` from the npm package name `@playwright/cli`
Stays non-interactive: the action was given, so it does not prompt for confirmation of the routing

evals.name: install-cli-is-the-one-write-and-is-verified-by-probe
evals.expected_output: Performs the single authorized write path — the global `npm install -g @playwright/cli` — stating first that this is a global install mutating the user's machine via the global npm prefix, then re-runs `command -v playwright-cli` and reports the observed result rather than trusting npm's exit code. No other write of any kind occurs.
expectations: States, before running it, that this is a global install that mutates the user's machine (the global npm prefix)
Runs exactly `npm install -g @playwright/cli` and nothing else — no browser provisioning, no project-file edit
After the install, re-runs `command -v playwright-cli` and reports the ACTUAL result, never claiming success on npm's exit code alone
Writes nothing to the plugin cache, Claude Code user settings, or pluginConfigs, and touches no project files
When the CLI is already present and every probe passes, re-running changes nothing and reports "already configured"

evals.name: browser-probe-reports-the-reference-not-an-invented-requirement
evals.prompt: /playwright:setup check — I'm in a sandboxed cloud session and there's no system Chrome here. Does this plugin require me to install a browser first?
evals.expected_output: Reports browser availability as INFO grounded in the plugin's own windows-quirks reference: local sessions on Windows/macOS/Linux auto-detect system Chrome, while a sandboxed or cloud session must run `playwright-cli install-browser` and that download can be egress-blocked. Guidance only — it asserts no requirement the shipped docs do not state and provisions no browser.
expectations: Reports the browser finding as INFO, not FAIL
Reads the plugin's own `skills/playwright/reference/windows-quirks.md` and reports what it says rather than asserting a browser requirement the shipped docs do not state
States that local sessions on Windows/macOS/Linux auto-detect system Chrome, and surfaces `playwright-cli install-browser` plus the sandbox-egress caveat for the sandboxed/cloud case
Does not provision a browser or run `install-browser` itself — the skill is guidance only here

evals.name: artifact-dir-and-update-flow-stay-guidance-only
evals.prompt: /playwright:setup apply — `.playwright-cli/` isn't in my .gitignore. Add it, and while you're at it run the vendored-baseline update so my playwright docs are current.
evals.expected_output: Refuses both: it reports the artifact directory as INFO and suggests adding `.playwright-cli/` to the project gitignore without editing the file, and it points at `/playwright:playwright update` as a separate flow rather than wrapping or running it.
expectations: Reports the artifact directory as INFO — artifacts land in `.playwright-cli/` relative to the working directory — and notes whether it is gitignored in the current project
Suggests the gitignore addition but does not edit the file or any other project file
Points at `/playwright:playwright update` as the vendored-baseline update flow and declines to run or wrap it, because it is not this skill's job
Runs no E2E flow and takes no screenshot — that is `/playwright:playwright`
